papers.title: Reframing strategic decision-making as a dynamic capability: A conceptual framework for AI enabled organizations
papers.journal: Advances in Business and Management Research
papers.abstract: Strategic decision-making is increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence (AI), yet existing theories continue to treat decision-making as an episodic managerial activity or view AI as a standalone analytical tool. This conceptual paper reframes strategic decision-making as a dynamic organizational capability enabled by AI. Drawing on dynamic capability theory and strategic decision-making research, the study develops an integrative framework explaining how AI enabled sensing, seizing, and transforming capabilities jointly shape strategic decision quality under conditions of environmental uncertainty. Rather than focusing on firm performance outcomes, the framework conceptualizes decision quality as an organizational outcome reflecting accuracy, timeliness, adaptability, and strategic alignment at the time decisions are made. By positioning AI as an embedded enabler of capability development rather than a substitute for managerial judgment, the paper explains heterogeneity in AI enabled strategic outcomes across organizations.
papers.summary_ja: AIを「エピソード的な分析ツール」ではなく「戦略的意思決定を支える動的ケイパビリティ」として再定義し、センシング・シージング・変革の3機能を通じた意思決定品質向上フレームワークを提示する。

papers.title: Experimentation in Organizations: An Integrative Review
papers.abstract: Organizations have long relied on experiments to guide decision-making. Yet, a comprehensive synthesis of this rich and timely empirical literature remains lacking. In this integrative review, we identify two primary streams of research (problem-solving-based experimentation and causal inference-based experimentation), which we organize using the classic variation-selection-retention framework. The problem-solving stream emphasizes iterative experimentation, learning from failure, and navigating organizational challenges, while the causal inference stream focuses on sharp identification, structured experimental designs, and bounded experiments, each rooted in distinct disciplinary traditions. Despite the differences, these perspectives offer complementary insights into how organizations experiment, learn, and adapt. By analyzing 177 empirical studies across several disciplines and integrating these parallel streams, we develop a unifying framework that highlights the key drivers, processes, and outcomes of organizational experimentation.
papers.summary_ja: 177本の実証研究を統合し、組織における実験を「問題解決型」と「因果推論型」の2ストリームに整理。variation-selection-retentionフレームワークで組織学習・適応の統合モデルを構築する。

papers.title: Towards Strong Sustainability: Exploring Reconfigurations of Sufficiency-Oriented and Regenerative Business Models
papers.abstract: Despite increasing adoption of sustainable business models, environmental decline and social disparities continue to accelerate. Strong sustainable business models offer an alternative by prioritizing ecological limits and systemic change. Drawing on an integrative literature review and business model modularization, this study examines how sufficiency-oriented business models and regenerative business models can be reconfigured to advance sustainability. Both share common elements such as longevity, stakeholder collaboration and reinvestment of profits for sustainable value creation, which indicates that they are compatible with different value logics. The study proposes a modular framework enabling businesses to reconfigure components from both models, while maintaining coherence of the dominant value logic by applying modularity principles.
papers.summary_ja: 環境悪化が続く現状を打破するため「強いサステナビリティ」を志向するビジネスモデルの再構成フレームワークを提案。充足性志向モデルと再生型モデルをモジュール的に組み合わせ、実現を阻む3つのシステム的フィードバックを同定する。

papers.title: More than just fair: Legitimizing AI through reciprocity, ethical AI characteristics and personal information sharing
papers.abstract: This research examines how perceived reciprocity and perceived ethical AI characteristics – fairness, accountability, and transparency (FAT principles) – shape consumers' willingness to share personal information and its downstream consequences in AI-mediated consumer-brand interactions. Grounded in social exchange theory, we conceptualize personal information sharing as a behavioral gateway through which ethical exchange cues translate into perceived algorithmic legitimacy and intention to co-create value.
papers.summary_ja: 知覚される互恵性とFAT原則（公正・説明責任・透明性）が消費者の情報共有意図とAI正当性認知を規定することを実証し、AI活用サービス設計の倫理的基盤を示す。

papers.title: Navigating the emotional landscape of urban futures: Exploring the role of feelings in participatory backcasting for net zero transitions
papers.abstract: Participatory backcasting is an established foresight method that engages stakeholders in the development of actions to achieve future goals. However, it overlooks the affective dimensions of transformative change. This paper presents an innovative methodology for participatory backcasting that integrates emotions into transition management processes in the context of an urban precinct undergoing net zero transformation in Melbourne, Australia. We report on a series of workshops designed to elicit stakeholders' emotional responses to future scenarios.
papers.summary_ja: 都市のネットゼロ移行に向けた参加型バックキャスティングに感情次元を統合した新手法を提案し、メルボルンのワークショップで実証。変革プロセスにおける感情的エンゲージメントの重要性を示す。

papers.title: Exploring value co-creation practices in public service conception: a project management approach
papers.journal: International Journal of Public Sector Management
papers.abstract: This article aims to improve understanding of value co-creation practices (VCPs) in public services by introducing a practical project management-based framework. Adopting a Public Administration and Management (PAM) perspective, public services can be viewed as evolving sets of value co-creation activities involving various stakeholders. This action research study of two school catering projects in Quebec involved collecting qualitative data through 29 semi-structured interviews and observation periods.
papers.summary_ja: 公共サービス企画における価値共創実践をプロジェクトマネジメント観点から分析し、2件の学校給食プロジェクトのアクションリサーチから実践的な共創フレームワークを提示する。

papers.title: AI capabilities for sustainable entrepreneurial innovation: the role of orientation, resilience, and turbulence effects in SMEs
papers.abstract: In the evolving landscape of sustainable development, artificial intelligence (AI) has become a critical enabler for small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) striving to achieve entrepreneurial sustainable development goals (ESDG). This study investigates how AI capabilities, encompassing human skills, technology, data-driven culture (DDC), and organizational learning intensity, contribute to ESDGs through both internal organizational mechanisms and external market dynamics.
papers.summary_ja: AI能力（人的スキル・技術・データ駆動文化・組織学習）がSMEのサステナブル起業家目標（ESDG）達成に与える影響を実証し、環境の乱高下が中間変数として機能することを示す。

papers.title: Research on service design touchpoints for green communities based on the community commons
papers.abstract: With increasing global attention to sustainable development, this study examines design touchpoints in green community services through the lens of community commons. A novel conceptual framework for the design touchpoint mechanism of service design is proposed. It begins with a system architecture that underpins green community service design touchpoints. Service design touchpoints are classified into public and individual types, and their respective and relational characteristics are analyzed.
papers.summary_ja: コミュニティ・コモンズの視点からグリーンコミュニティのサービスデザイン・タッチポイントを「公共型」と「個人型」に分類し、持続可能な地域サービス設計の概念フレームワークを提示する。

papers.title: Accelerating sustainable housing transitions: A case study of the window industry in Australia
papers.abstract: The high-performance window industry in Australia requires deliberate efforts to accelerate the transition. Analysis of niche-regime-system dynamics through the Multi-Level Perspective and lock-in mechanisms reveals complex social, political, and techno-economic relations and path dependency. Research with the niche industry and sustainable housing system identifies an integrated set of multi-dimensional, multi-relational interventions.
papers.summary_ja: オーストラリアの窓産業を事例にマルチレベル・パースペクティブ（MLP）とロックイン機構を用いて住宅サステナビリティ移行を分析し、ニッチ×レジーム×システムの多次元的介入戦略を提示する。

papers.title: Assessing the Impact of a Quintuple Helix Framework on Smart City Performance: A Country-Level Analysis of EU Capitals
papers.abstract: Although Smart City transitions are typically assessed using technological and financial indicators, the underlying structural correlates remain insufficiently explored. This study examines how different forms of capital within the Quintuple Helix model—natural, social, intellectual, economic and institutional (governance)—are associated with a country's position in the Global Smart Cities Index and the Eco-Innovation Index. The methodology is based on data from 26 EU Member States.
papers.summary_ja: EU26カ国の首都を対象にクイントuple・ヘリックスモデルの5資本形態（自然・社会・知識・経済・ガバナンス）がスマートシティ指数・エコイノベーション指数と相関することを実証分析する。
